contract.goal: Complete versioned backup and atomic restore for all implemented persistent feature data, preserving identities and safe defaults.
scope: Only /Users/orderly_ray/Projects/thinkV2, accepted clean baseline53fb5da83c841d565f8c2f627de4d81905a1abf6. Formal PM addendum E9 X1-X3 and baseline C1-C10. One CP8 task; build on existing backup implementation.

X1: Include existing notes/drafts/categories/trash/title ownership/reminder configurations plus correction vocabulary text, calendar immutable provenance and import fingerprint/idempotence mappings, accepted AI title/category provenance, and explicit relation edges with stable endpoint mappings. No fabricated optional fields. No credentials, raw audio, logs/cache or unaccepted temporary AI suggestions; no model/runtime assets.

X2: Introduce explicit versioned format contract for added fields; handle prior v1 files explicitly without silent data loss, reject unknown newer versions/unknown meaningful fields, retain strict bounds/checksum/UTF8/reference/uniqueness checks. No silent same-version semantic expansion. Old-reader rejection of new format and new-reader old-file behavior must be tested.

Extend existing preview/merge, no whole-library overwrite. Preserve local conflicting originals, explicit conflict copies and complete note/category/draft/relation/calendar/AI provenance ID mapping. Repeated identical export id/hash remains idempotent; same export id/different content rejected. Re-importing calendar after restored provenance cannot overwrite local originals or silently duplicate mappings.

Restore is atomic with failure rollback across all restored durable fields; preview invalidated by relevant intervening local changes. Correction vocabulary currently SharedPreferences: choose minimal safe single transactional ownership or equivalent demonstrably recoverable approach; preserve existing vocabulary and never claim atomic DB+preferences without proof. Necessary local schema/storage migration for CP8 allowed; no new voice feature/model work.

Restored reminders stay disabled without scheduling. Do not export service secrets/configuration or enable AI on restore; restored AI requires local configuration/confirmation. In-memory state must reflect restored data and disabled AI, not stale active consent. Existing unaffected local reminder plans remain unchanged. Explain merge behavior for vocabulary conflicts and provenance identity deterministically.

X3: Actual Android synthetic full-field export/restore and system file workflow: old/new formats, empty database, conflicting notes/categories/relations and source mappings, repeated restore, subsequent calendar import, corrupt/truncated/unsupported files and injected transaction/write failures. Compare exact durable fields and original DB on failure; use tested copies only. All implemented data exported in one consistent snapshot or explicitly coordinated snapshot, including vocabulary.

Necessary host/build/lint and affected regressions. Update current backup coverage/UI documentation and exact format specification. No third-party dependency unless safety gate passed. Xiaomi15 SAF/provider behavior and family backup trial remain pending.
out_of_scope: No new voice controls/models/accuracy work, AI provider requests, graph, unrelated UI redesign, cloud sync/accounts/payment/publication, Flutter/KMP, raw audio or personal data/device access. No separate developer tasks or further checkpoint.
acceptance: X1-X3 and C1-C10 relevant behavior have exact field/identity round-trip and failure evidence; full implemented-data backup covers vocabulary/calendar/acceptedAI/relations with safe exclusions.

Version compatibility, conflict copy mapping, idempotence, stale preview, atomic rollback, restored reminders disabled/AI off and subsequent calendar import verified in actual Android synthetic flows, supported by meaningful host tests.
Build/lint and necessary regressions pass, final clean commit/APK/evidence hashes documented; no unknown dependency or unrelated modifications. Xiaomi/family/provider/voice gaps explicitly retained.
evidence_required: ACK exact task/attempt/hash/baseline. RESULT COMPLETE/BLOCKED/PRODUCT_DECISION_REQUIRED, file purposes, format/migration decisions, commands/results, X1-X3 matrix, old/new format fixtures with sanitized field comparisons, actual SAF/rollback/idempotence/calendar-after-restore evidence, exclusions proof, exact final commit/APK and manifest. Report unverified items and next recommendation then stop.
stop_conditions: Complete this CP8 task then stop and report commander. Do not begin Xiaomi/family/other CP automatically. Preserve unknown edits.

Pause affected delivery for possible data loss, non-atomic restore, privacy boundary violation, unknown dependency or requirement expansion; report concrete evidence. Do not use private data or overwrite source backups. Engineering completion is not full-App or family delivery completion.
